extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the question: (1) The 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas (e.g., '3,900'), which was fixed by casting to numeric; (2) Two rows had negative flipper lengths (rows 2 and 50), which were excluded as they violate biological plausibility; (3) One row had a body mass of 6700g, exceeding the maximum allowed of 6500g, which was excluded as an outlier. After these fixes, the average body mass by species was calculated. The results are: Adelie: 3701.39g, Chinstrap: 3754.55g, Gentoo: 5081.58g. No further issues were found in the relevant columns.
